faq.q: How is a titanium water bottle cage manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium water bottle cage is manufactured using Wire drawing; CNC swaging; CNC turning; Thread rolling. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for titanium water bottle cage?
faq.a: Alternative materials include stainless steel (heavier, susceptible to corrosion) and aluminum (lower strength, shorter fatigue life). The alternative manufacturing method is Centerless grinding from bar stock (higher material waste, longer lead time).
